text:
maria_g: Heads up — Drydock (dedicated pool dp-42) is reporting TPS SLO violations and a flurry of 429s starting ~09:15 UTC. Customers seeing increased tail latency too.

samir_ops: on it. are we seeing admission rejects or proxy 429s?

maria_g: admission rejects predominantly. quick grep from admission-controller logs:
```
2026-03-17T09:15:12Z admission: request_id=9a8f reject=RATE_LIMIT reason=no_burst_credits account=drydock
2026-03-17T09:16:03Z admission: request_id=9a9b accept account=drydock tokens=64
2026-03-17T09:16:58Z admission: request_id=9ac3 reject=RATE_LIMIT reason=headroom_exhausted account=drydock
```

alex_p: ok that lines up with prometheus: `admission_reject_total{reason=\"no_credits\",pool=\"dp-42\"}` spiked to +180 in 5m. query I ran: `sum(increase(admission_reject_total{pool=\"dp-42\"}[5m]))` returns 187.

irene_se: any autoscale events? maybe pool didn't spin GPUs fast enough.

samir_ops: checked cluster autoscaler: dp-42 attempted scale from 4->6 at 09:14 but node provisioning lagged ~2m due to capacity. Meanwhile token-per-second budget (burst credits) consumed quickly because a noisy tenant had large concurrent short requests.

maria_g: noisy tenant? Customer says they triggered batch job sending 2k small requests in <30s. should have been queued by their client backoff.

alex_p: two mitigation options now: 1) manually add temporary burst credits for account to avoid rejects, 2) apply admission override to allow degraded throughput but avoid hard 429s (throttle to 50% of peak). Which do we prefer now?

samir_ops: prefer admission override + scale. adding credits masks root cause. override command (run from ops console):
```
POST /internal/admin/admission/override
{
  \"pool\": \"dp-42\",
  \"account\": \"drydock\",
  \"mode\": \"soft-allow\",
  \"throttle_pct\": 50,
  \"duration\": \"15m\"
}
```

ingest-bot: FYI automated detection flagged dp-42 as \"noisy-tenant-surge\" and created a ticket: INGEST-3912.

billing_bot: Note: one-off burst credit grants must be approved by billing ops. Use admin UI -> Accounts -> Drydock -> Emergency Credits. Audit will record grant.

irene_se: meanwhile, can someone run the following prometheus checks to confirm headroom numbers?
```
sum(kvcache_prefix_hit_bytes) by (pool)
admission_burst_credit_balance{pool=\"dp-42\"}
```

alex_p: ran `admission_burst_credit_balance{pool=\"dp-42\"}` —  current value = 0.0 at 09:17. previous hour average ~1200.

samir_ops: pushing override now to avoid customer-visible 429s, and initiating manual scale to add 2 GPUs to dp-42.

maria_g: thanks. any risk with soft-allow? will latencies blow up?

samir_ops: soft-allow trades strict token enforcement for queued/throttled requests at proxy; we'll cap concurrency per-account so p99 may increase but 429s drop. ok for 15m window.

alex_p: scaling request submitted to infra: req id #scale-772. infra console shows nodes provisioning.

maria_g: after override: customer reports 429s drop to near-zero but tail latency hits +200ms for some requests. acceptable for now.

samir_ops: confirmed admission_reject_total fell to single digits in 5m window post-override.

irene_se: record of root cause: noisy tenant at Drydock triggered burst drain while cluster autoscale lagged. two contributing factors: burst-credit pool too low for this account's SLA and autoscaler slow during AZ capacity pressure.

maria_g: next actions:
- samir: follow-up with infra on autoscaler tuning / prewarm policies for dp-42 (oncall ticket assigned).
- irene: recommend increasing headroom/burst-credit guardrails for accounts with frequent short bursts; propose formula based on 99th percentile request rate and warm-up time.
- alex: run replay on staging to repro (simulate 2k small requests in 30s) and test admission override behavior.
- billing_bot: pls add emergency credit grant flow doc link to the ticket.

billing_bot: Emergency credits flow: https://redwood/docs/billing/emergency-credits. Approvals required: Billing Lead + CS manager.

maria_g: can we close once scaling and override ended?

samir_ops: scaling completed at 09:25, override auto-removed at 09:31. Observed steady state after 09:35. I'll leave postmortem notes in SUPPORT-2189.

maria_g: thanks all. Will open a short postmortem focusing on headroom formulas and autoscaler prewarm. Marking P0->P2 since customer impact was transient and mitigated. :white_check_mark:

alex_p: adding repro artifacts to SUPPORT-2189: small request generator script and prometheus queries used.

maria_g: closing thread, will ping when the postmortem is ready.
